headline: On last trading day, Sensex fell 319 points as inflation concerns snapped the market's winning streak.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on investor sentiment
Rising crude oil prices added pressure to the domestic market
Global sentiment was impacted by the ongoing Nvidia crisis
Profit booking occurred after a three-week winning streak
whatHappening: The Sensex dropped 319 points to close the last session
Nifty50 ended at 25,144, slipping below the 25,150 mark
Indian markets recorded their third consecutive weekly gain despite the Friday decline
A global Microsoft service outage caused disruptions across various sectors
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices ended lower with the Sensex falling 319 points, snapping a recent winning streak. Inflation worries and rising crude oil prices weighed on investor sentiment, although markets still secured a third consecutive weekly gain. Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance were among the stocks seeing significant downward movement.
